# LLM-based Semantic Extraction Pipeline

This module provides infrastructure for extracting semantic information from source code files using a Large Language Model (LLM). It manages budgeted, validated LLM calls with deterministic caching, anchors facts to observed code symbols, and outputs validated facts on business rules, features, and risks. The process enforces evidence discipline by ensuring LLM-derived anchors map only to deterministically observed symbols.
